verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a models list or get endpoint that an agent could call to enumerate the live catalog. The all-models documentation page, deprecations page and changelog are human-readable catalogs, not a programmatic endpoint. OpenAI-library compatibility is mentioned, but nothing says it exposes a models endpoint, so these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint
